rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for the Olympic Games.

example.english: The Olympics have many new stars this time.
example.traditional: 今屆奧運有好多新星喎。
example.jyutping: gam1 gaai3 ou3 wan6 jau5 hou2 do1 san1 sing1 wo3

rows.note: A speaker uses this fuller form when explicitly referring to the Olympic Games as an event.

example.english: The Olympics opening ceremony will be held on Friday.
example.traditional: 奧運會開幕禮會喺星期五舉行。
example.jyutping: ou3 wan6 wui6 hoi1 mok6 lai5 wui5 hai2 sing1 kei4 ng5 geoi2 hang4
